name: LAST_DAY
shortDescription: Last day of the month a date falls in
description: Returns the last day of the month that contains the given date or timestamp.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Date whose month end is returned

examples.title: End of the month
examples.description: Last day of the month each order was placed in
examples.sql: SELECT LAST_DAY(created_at) as month_end FROM orders

examples.title: Month end beside the row
examples.description: Project the month end next to the order
examples.sql: SELECT id, LAST_DAY(created_at) as month_end FROM orders LIMIT 10
